paragraphs: Rabbi Shefatai. (Shefatyah, son of David, II Samuel 3:4.) Mentioned in Megillah 32a, reporting five statements in Rabbi Yochanan's name. One of his statements is also cited in his name in Soferim 3:10.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Biblical Shefatyah is a separate parenthetical, not an identity claim. The supplied source has five statements and a period after Megillah 32, rendered 32a; older machine alternatives remain in the editorial record.
The consulted Megillah 32a has five attributions to Rabbi Yochanan through Shefatyah. Soferim 3:10 uses Shefatai for the parallel about reading and study without melody.
